description: Custom React hook 'usePhoneOtp' for handling OTP verification, user profile update, and related UI interactions in a multi-vendor food delivery app.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during OTP sending, displays appropriate flash messages.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful OTP send, displays confirmation message.

methods.name: onUpdateUserError
methods.description: Handles errors during user update, displays flash messages.

methods.name: onUpdateUserCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful user update, navigates to appropriate screen.

methods.name: onCodeFilled
methods.description: Verifies OTP code and updates user profile if valid.

methods.name: onSendOTPHandler
methods.description: Sends OTP to user's phone number.

methods.name: resendOtp
methods.description: Generates new OTP and triggers resend.
